## A1 Directory Detail Enricher

Reusable child workflow for:

- Mad Barn
- FarrierIQ
- Best of Lexington
- NewHorse
- HorseProFinder

The source adapter passes listing records in parsed_records, profiles,
or records. This workflow deduplicates them and processes every
received record within the overall approved A1 request ceiling.

Records with no dedicated profile URL are retained unchanged through
Build Empty Detail Control. Invalid, blocked or failed detail pages
produce item-level failed detail records rather than dropping the
listing.

Required inputs include:

run_id
source_job_id
source_id
segment
location
location_key
source_scope_key
source_exhausted
next_cursor
parsed_records/profiles/records

Optional model inputs:

litellm_base_url
litellm_model
max_markdown_chars

The workflow preserves the listing adapter's location, cursor and
source-exhaustion state. Detail enrichment must never replace listing
pagination control.

Detail URLs are limited to approved source-specific HTTPS hosts and
paths. Full Markdown and raw model output are not returned.

The workflow uses JavaScript Code nodes. Keep it inactive until
no-profile, invalid-URL, detail-failure, partial-result, location and
cursor-preservation tests pass.
